description:
Professional Foodie and Designer Frankie Gaw explores his recipe for success with #AdobeCreativeCloud. Working across Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Premiere, @LittleFatBoy 's process is baked into our suite of tools. From brainstorming to designing packaging, watch him mix his artistic vision and influences—like his grandma's cooking—into No Pressure Patisserie, a pop-up cake shop.

What's inspiring your work? Let us know!
